extracted.intended_audience: early-stage innovators (especially student entrepreneurs), faculty running innovation programs, and founders looking for accelerators or grant opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Information about VentureWell programs, competitions, and supports for student-led and early-stage science & technology ventures, including program focus/eligibility signals (e.g., DEBUT Challenge, E-Team, Ocean Enterprise Accelerator).

rubrics_metrics.name: DEBUT Challenge eligibility & focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The DEBUT Challenge is open to student teams (undergraduate) working on solutions to unmet health and clinical problems; the Challenge offers a total of $190,000 in prizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'DEBUT 2026 — With $190,000 in prizes, the DEBUT Challenge is open to student teams working on solutions to unmet health and clinical problems.' Implies target applicant: undergraduate student teams; project domain: health and clinical problems; emphasizes practical solutions to unmet clinical needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: E-Team Program selection signal
rubrics_metrics.description: Spring 2026 E-Team Program cohort exemplifies 'innovative thinking and a clear vision for meaningful change.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'These 26 student ventures exemplify innovative thinking and a clear vision for meaningful change.' Suggests selection favors student ventures that demonstrate clear vision and innovation aimed at meaningful impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ocean Enterprise Accelerator target stage & domain
rubrics_metrics.description: Ocean Enterprise Accelerator targets Stage 0 startups developing technologies to transform the future of America's coasts/the blue economy, offering mentorship and access to a pipeline of up to $140K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'Ocean Enterprise Accelerator — The Spring 2026 Stage 0 startups are developing technologies that will transform the future of America’s coasts.' and 'Building the future of the blue economy through mentorship and access to a pipeline of up to $140K.' Implies eligibility: very early stage (Stage 0) ventures focused on coastal/blue-economy technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blueprint MedTech Incubator Hubs / Neurotechnology commercialization focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Blueprint MedTech Incubator Hubs provide commercialization support to neurotechnology projects (referred to on the page as 'Artificial Sight').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'Artificial Sight — Via the Blueprint MedTech Incubator Hubs Program, we provide commercialization support to neurotechnology of the future.' Implies programmatic focus on medtech/neurotechnology commercialization activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty Initiatives audience & purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty Initiatives support faculty developing programs that cultivate student innovators and promote institutional change through grants, workshops, training, and conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'We support faculty in developing programs that cultivate student innovators and promote institutional change through grants, workshops, training, and conferences.' Suggests eligibility/target: faculty seeking institutional program development and training resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: VentureWell target mission & project fit
rubrics_metrics.description: VentureWell's overall mission focuses on cultivating inventors, innovators, and entrepreneurs in science and technology who aim to solve the world’s most difficult problems and create lasting impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original page text: 'We envision a world in which science and technology innovators have the support, training, and access to networks and resources they need... We foster collaboration among the best minds from research labs, classrooms, and beyond to advance innovation and entrepreneurship education...' Implies preference for STEM/science- and technology-based projects with potential for societal impact and for applicants who are students, researchers, or faculty.
